name: academic-research-skills
description: Academic Research Skills for Claude Code: research → write → review → revise → finalize
one_liner: A set of instructions that teaches an AI assistant to act like a research collaborator — helping search, write, review, and polish an academic paper step by step instead of just spitting out one draft.
buyer: A graduate student or early-career researcher under deadline pressure who wants an AI co-author for literature review and drafting without paying for an editing service.
business_use_cases: A PhD student uses it to speed up the literature-review-to-draft pipeline for a conference submission.
An academic editing service uses it internally to give junior editors a consistent first-pass review checklist.
A research-heavy startup (market research, policy) adapts the workflow for internal report writing.

money_ideas.idea: Package a 'AI research assistant' onboarding service for grad students — set up the skill, teach the workflow, charge per semester.

steal_this: Offer a flat-fee 'get your literature review AI-assisted in one sitting' session to grad students in your network this weekend, using this skill as the engine.
